summary: Documents now come with a link: when she publishes one, her reply carries a link that opens it in the web app (signed in), and the web app opens a document by that short link.
details: The link uses a 12-character handle of the document's id, so it passes the filter that blocks long identifiers; the filter itself is unchanged.
A link only opens a document the person may read; a handle that matches nothing, or more than one of their documents, shows the same 'not one of your documents' page.
limitations: The link appears only once `[documents] public_url` is set in the live config; until then she says the document is under Documents, by its title.
